sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
title: What the Cities Kept
prose: We walked between the cities and marked what needed care: a loose wall, an open channel, a rooted bank. We also marked the places already being used, so nobody would mend them empty. I had come looking for abandoned cities. I left a page about their inhabitants.

choices.label: Keep the page
choices.line: I wrote it down before going on.
